summary: IHS Holding Limited (NYSE: IHS) filed a Form 6-K on August 7, 2026, announcing completion of the sale of its Latin America tower operations, including IHS Brazil 1 and IHS Colombia with approximately 9,000 sites, to Macquarie Asset Management. The transaction, initially announced on February 17, 2026, marks IHS's exit from Latin America. J.P. Morgan acted as financial advisor to IHS. The filing does not disclose the purchase price or any other financial terms. The sale follows a prior divestiture of IHS Fiber Brasil's 51% stake in I-Systems to TIM S.A. completed in May 2026. What to watch: any subsequent special distributions or capital allocation updates, and whether Macquarie assumes operational risks.
